title: The Absolute Twistor Line and the Geometry of $\overline{\text{Spec}\, \mathbf Z}$
summary: We construct the absolute algebraic geometry of the compactification $\overline{\text{Spec}\, \mathbf Z}$ by amalgamating the affine absolute curve $(\text{Spec}\, \mathbf Z)_{\mathbf{F}_{1}}$ with an archimedean component defined over the signed extension $\mathbf{F}_{1^2}$ of $\mathbf{F}_1$. By adjoining a formal imaginary unit to the absolute projective line, we obtain an equivariant topos endowed with a canonical geometric inversion symmetry, which induces the twistor real structure on its complex points.
